name: Parastage
source:
Is it wrong to want to go back? Parastage is a horror visual novel that follows a boy named Itsuki and the adventure he goes on alongside his friends

Look around, solve puzzles, and talk to your fellow drama society peers.

The curtain is only now opening on this "Parastage."
